_meta.source: Canva design DAG5X2TPfyU "- Midia Kit - Lorena Maruch." (10 pages, 794x1123). Read-only extraction.
notes: Text marked source=canva_text is the text-layer content from the Canva element data, copied verbatim (including typos and double spaces).
Text marked source=screenshot is transcribed from the Instagram profile-header screenshot (an image, page 1). Its capture date is unknown.
Several cover texts are drawn in capitals in the design (a text-transform the Canva API does not expose). The text-layer casing is kept here, and 'rendered' gives what you see on the page.
English translations are faithful renderings for the website. They are not in the source.

bio.pt: Formada em cinema e audiovisual, trabalha com publicidades no seu instagram há 8 anos, carrega seu olhar em todos seus projetos, construindo conceitos e elementos artísticos. Já assinou direção criativa em projetos para marcas nacionais e internacionais de grande porte nos setores de moda, beleza,  alimentação e mundo fitness.
bio.en: A graduate in film and audiovisual production, she has been creating sponsored content on her Instagram for 8 years, bringing her own eye to every project by building concepts and artistic elements. She has led creative direction on projects for major national and international brands in fashion, beauty, food and fitness.
